name: Deep Elem Mine
summary: Deep Elem Mine is an excavation site nestled in the heart of Silverpine Forest. Once an active operation, it was overrun when Archmage Arugal's dark magic swept through the region, transforming its miners into savage worgen.

sections.title: A Den of Beasts
sections.body: Situated central to Silverpine Forest, the Deep Elem Mine once served the living inhabitants of Lordaeron as an ordinary resource vein. When Archmage Arugal unleashed the lupine nightmare upon the forest, his feral curse spread deep into the tunnels. The laborers inside succumbed to the affliction, turning into vicious worgen who abandoned their pickaxes to claim the cavern as a predatory lair.

sections.title: Grimson and Forsaken Ambition
sections.body: The pack within the mine is commanded by Grimson the Pale, the former mine foreman who retained his cunning even after his monstrous transformation. Recognizing the strategic value of the tunnels and their ore, the Forsaken at the Sepulcher take a keen interest in reclaiming the site. Under orders backed by the authority of Dreadlord Varimathras, Forsaken agents seek to sever Grimson's head and purge the beasts so the Horde can secure the mine's wealth.

faq.q: What is inside Deep Elem Mine?
aliases: who lives in deep elem mine
faq.answer: The mine is infested with hostile worgen afflicted by Archmage Arugal's magic. They are led by their former human foreman, Grimson the Pale, who now rules the pack deep within the tunnels.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken want Deep Elem Mine cleared?
faq.answer: The Forsaken seek to exploit the mine's natural mineral wealth to bolster their war efforts in Lordaeron. Dalar Dawnweaver and the leadership at the Sepulcher intend to claim its resources in the name of Dreadlord Varimathras once the worgen are eradicated.

Grimson was originally the mortal foreman overseeing operations at Deep Elem Mine. After Arugal's feral curse transformed the workers, Grimson became a cunning worgen alpha who retained enough intellect to command the pack inhabiting the mine.

faq.q: How did the worgen get into the mine?
aliases: why are there worgen in the mine
faq.answer: They were not outsiders who moved in; the original miners were transformed by the spread of Archmage Arugal's curse across Silverpine Forest, turning the workforce into monsters where they worked.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, securing the mine is both an economic necessity and a direct mandate from the Sepulcher to break Arugal's encroaching grip on central Silverpine.
Though currently hazardous due to the feral pack residing within, the mine represents one of Silverpine's richest subterranean mineral deposits.
